scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Applies to binary length-n words of exactly three ones and exact scattered subsequences of length three. No theorem is asserted for other weights, alphabets, or deck lengths. The all-n proof is algebraic; finite checks support but cannot replace it. The generating function was explicitly conjectured in the cited 2021 source; possible unindexed equivalent independent proofs remain an originality risk. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Exact weight-three binary three-deck classes and the conjectured generating function
